title: Sparkly tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='5' y='80' width='90' height='8' rx='3' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- tent left flap -->
  <polygon points='50,18 18,80 50,80' fill='#FF6B35'/>
  <!-- tent right flap -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,80 50,80' fill='#FF9F1C'/>
  <!-- tent front opening -->
  <polygon points='50,30 38,80 62,80' fill='#5C4033'/>
  <!-- tent front opening inner glow -->
  <polygon points='50,36 41,80 59,80' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- tent pole top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='4' fill='#C0C0C0'/>
  <!-- tent left edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,20 20,78 26,78' fill='#FF8C5A'/>
  <!-- tent right edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,20 80,78 74,78' fill='#FFBF69'/>
  <!-- tent base line left -->
  <rect x='18' y='77' width='32' height='3' rx='1' fill='#D94F1E'/>
  <!-- tent base line right -->
  <rect x='50' y='77' width='32' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E08A1E'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFFF66'>
    <!-- sparkle top left -->
    <polygon points='25,28 27,33 32,33 28,36 30,41 25,38 20,41 22,36 18,33 23,33'/>
    <!-- sparkle top right -->
    <polygon points='78,22 80,27 85,27 81,30 83,35 78,32 73,35 75,30 71,27 76,27'/>
    <!-- sparkle mid left -->
    <polygon points='12,55 14,59 18,59 15,62 16,66 12,63 8,66 9,62 6,59 10,59'/>
    <!-- sparkle mid right -->
    <polygon points='88,50 90,54 94,54 91,57 92,61 88,58 84,61 85,57 82,54 86,54'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom left -->
    <polygon points='30,68 31,71 34,71 32,73 33,76 30,74 27,76 28,73 26,71 29,71'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom right -->
    <polygon points='72,65 73,68 76,68 74,70 75,73 72,71 69,73 70,70 68,68 71,68'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='12' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='42' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='88' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='90' r='2' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  <!-- star crosses -->
  <g stroke='#FFFACD' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='20' y1='45' x2='24' y2='45'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='43' x2='22' y2='47'/>
    <line x1='82' y1='40' x2='86' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='38' x2='84' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='8' x2='55' y2='12'/>
  </g>
</svg>
